First, open the export config and confirm the normalized next-run time in the new timezone. Then, make sure the source report still exists and is accessible. Next, ensure the destination credentials are valid. Finally, re-enable any auto-pausings that may have occurred and save the export. After saving, the scheduled runs will be recalculated based on the new timezone, and they will resume from the next valid slot rather than backfilling. If the problem persists, please contact support for further assistance. [7] (support.md / Contact information)
